functions.invalidate_property_image_pilot_review: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION invalidate_property_image_pilot_review() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE target_property_id UUID; BEGIN IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN target_property_id := OLD.property_id; ELSE target_property_id := NEW.property_id; END IF; UPDATE properties SET pilot_review_status = 'pending', pilot_reviewed_at = NULL, pilot_reviewed_by = NULL, pilot_review_note = NULL, status = CASE WHEN status = 'published' THEN 'draft' ELSE status END, updated_at = NOW() WHERE id = target_property_id AND pilot_review_status = 'approved'; IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
functions.invalidate_property_pilot_review: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION invalidate_property_pilot_review() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF OLD.pilot_review_status = 'approved' AND ROW(OLD.name, OLD.property_type, OLD.description, OLD.city, OLD.district, OLD.country_code, OLD.max_guests, OLD.bedrooms, OLD.bathrooms, OLD.nightly_price, OLD.cleaning_fee, OLD.currency, OLD.min_stay_nights, OLD.max_stay_nights, OLD.cancellation_policy_id, OLD.check_in_time, OLD.check_out_time, OLD.house_rules, OLD.address_line_1, OLD.address_line_2, OLD.postal_town, OLD.county, OLD.postcode, OLD.private_location, OLD.compliance_status) IS DISTINCT FROM ROW(NEW.name, NEW.property_type, NEW.description, NEW.city, NEW.district, NEW.country_code, NEW.max_guests, NEW.bedrooms, NEW.bathrooms, NEW.nightly_price, NEW.cleaning_fee, NEW.currency, NEW.min_stay_nights, NEW.max_stay_nights, NEW.cancellation_policy_id, NEW.check_in_time, NEW.check_out_time, NEW.house_rules, NEW.address_line_1, NEW.address_line_2, NEW.postal_town, NEW.county, NEW.postcode, NEW.private_location, NEW.compliance_status) THEN NEW.pilot_review_status := 'pending'; NEW.pilot_reviewed_at := NULL; NEW.pilot_reviewed_by := NULL; NEW.pilot_review_note := NULL; IF OLD.status = 'published' THEN NEW.status := 'draft'; END IF; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$

triggers.properties_invalidate_pilot_review@prope: CREATE TRIGGER properties_invalidate_pilot_review BEFORE UPDATE OF name, property_type, description, city, district, country_code, max_guests, bedrooms, bathrooms, nightly_price, cleaning_fee, currency, min_stay_nights, max_stay_nights, cancellation_policy_id, check_in_time, check_out_time, house_rules, address_line_1, address_line_2, postal_town, county, postcode, private_location, compliance_status ON properties FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION invalidate_property_pilot_review()
triggers.property_images_invalidate_pilot_review@: CREATE TRIGGER property_images_invalidate_pilot_review AFTER INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON property_images FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION invalidate_property_image_pilot_review()

functions.protect_cancelled_hotel_booking: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_cancelled_hotel_booking() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF OLD.room_type_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.status IN ('cancelled','refunded') AND NEW.status IN ('pending_payment','confirmed','completed','disputed') THEN NEW.status := OLD.status; END IF; IF OLD.room_type_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.room_type_id OR OLD.room_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.room_quantity OR OLD.room_name_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.room_name_snapshot THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Room reservation snapshot is immutable'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

triggers.protect_cancelled_hotel_booking@bookings: CREATE TRIGGER protect_cancelled_hotel_booking BEFORE UPDATE ON bookings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_cancelled_hotel_booking()

functions.protect_cancelled_hotel_booking: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_cancelled_hotel_booking() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ BEGIN IF OLD.room_type_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.status IN ('cancelled','refunded') AND NEW.status IN ('pending_payment','confirmed','completed','disputed') THEN NEW.status := OLD.status; END IF; IF OLD.room_type_id IS NOT NULL AND OLD.status='pending_payment' AND NEW.status='confirmed' AND OLD.hold_expires_at IS NOT NULL AND OLD.hold_expires_at<=clock_timestamp() THEN NEW.status := 'cancelled'; NEW.hotel_late_payment := TRUE; END IF; IF OLD.room_type_id IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.room_type_id OR OLD.room_quantity IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.room_quantity OR OLD.room_name_snapshot IS DISTINCT FROM NEW.room_name_snapshot THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Room reservation snapshot is immutable'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$
functions.protect_property_inventory_model: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION protect_property_inventory_model() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE old_hotel BOOLEAN; new_hotel BOOLEAN; BEGIN old_hotel := lower(trim(COALESCE(OLD.property_type,''))) IN ('hotel','aparthotel'); new_hotel := lower(trim(COALESCE(NEW.property_type,''))) IN ('hotel','aparthotel'); IF old_hotel IS DISTINCT FROM new_hotel AND ( EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM bookings WHERE property_id=OLD.id AND check_out>CURRENT_DATE AND status IN ('pending_payment','confirmed','completed','disputed')) OR (old_hotel AND EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM hotel_room_types WHERE property_id=OLD.id AND active)) THEN RAISE EXCEPTION 'Pause room types and resolve existing reservations before changing between hotel and whole-property accommodation' USING ERRCODE='23514'; END IF; RETURN NEW; END $function$

triggers.protect_property_inventory_model@propert: CREATE TRIGGER protect_property_inventory_model BEFORE UPDATE OF property_type ON properties FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION protect_property_inventory_model()

functions.lock_booking_authorization_audit: CREATE OR REPLACE FUNCTION lock_booking_authorization_audit() RETURNS trigger LANGUAGE plpgsql AS $function$ DECLARE booking_ids uuid[] := ARRAY[]::uuid[]; BEGIN IF TG_OP <> 'INSERT' THEN IF OLD.object_type = 'booking' AND (OLD.action = 'booking_hold_expired' OR (OLD.action = 'booking_cancelled' AND OLD.new_state->>'cancellationKind' = 'paid') THEN booking_ids := array_append(booking_ids, OLD.object_id); END IF; END IF; IF TG_OP <> 'DELETE' THEN IF NEW.object_type = 'booking' AND (NEW.action = 'booking_hold_expired' OR (NEW.action = 'booking_cancelled' AND NEW.new_state->>'cancellationKind' = 'paid') THEN booking_ids := array_append(booking_ids, NEW.object_id); END IF; END IF; -- KEY SHARE conflicts with the workers' FOR UPDATE booking lock. -- Lock both old and new bookings in deterministic order on reassignment. PERFORM b.id FROM bookings b WHERE b.id = ANY(booking_ids) ORDER BY b.id FOR KEY SHARE; IF TG_OP = 'DELETE' THEN RETURN OLD; END IF; RETURN NEW; END; $function$
